title: Explicit thermodynamic wet-bulb feasibility and adjacent floating-input dry boundary

receiver.oracle: Tabulated primary saturation-pressure intervals and an independently expressed moist-air/condensate energy balance; no producer helper import.
receiver.execution: Issue all 20 fixed calls and all 12 relational calls before aggregate assertions; preserve raw verdicts, solver errors and strict-JSON errors separately.

pre_execution_reporting_revision.scope: Keep nonfinite evidence printable after strict-JSON failure and guard unexpected saturated-RH types; no changes to inputs, count, order, oracle or tolerances.

fixed.claims: Zero humidity on the three infeasible states must refuse before scalar comparison; zero humidity on genuine dry air and RH1 on saturation must approve. All claim tolerances zero.
alternate_inputs: 20C RH0.5 takes precedence over explicit Twb-40C

boundary.recipe: For each anchor query the unchanged public RH0 inverse once, then submit exactly t-1e-4, predecessor(t), t, successor(t), t+1e-4; record the anchor and every submitted temperature as binary64 hex.
requirements: Each anchor is an admitted dry state without new metadata and has a finite wet bulb in its named same-phase interval.
Exactly one of predecessor(t) and t is the tagged negative lower endpoint; its immediate upper endpoint must be admitted without a tag.
The far lower input refuses without a tag; the far upper input admits strictly positive humidity without a tag.
The other near input has no fixed verdict. Any independently present tag must be the submitted value and its next float upward, with positive-sign zero humidity.
An anchor failure is a failure and does not silently drop its five planned requests.
boundary.interpretation: Public inverse self-consistency only, independent from the table/energy physical oracle. No universal RH0 round-trip or exact thermodynamic root claim.
boundary.approval_count: No exact boundary or combined tally is frozen. The stated relations imply 8-10 boundary approvals and2-4 boundary refusals.
boundary.pre_execution_correction: Rejected an earlier proposed all-neighbor monotonic RRAAA/RAAAA expectation and +8-ULP strict-positive claim before any numerical execution. Celsius-to-Kelvin quantization can create local plateaus; the final fixed plan uses far offsets and only the necessary adjacent pair.

scope.input: Only explicit t_wb_c feasibility and its floating-input dry boundary.
scope.positive: Return finite positive signed humidity verbatim, including tiny positives.
scope.zero: Canonical positive zero without bracket evidence.
scope.negative: Inspect only u=nextafter(t,+infinity). Admit zero only when both checked endpoints are finite/admissible, have p>0, 0<pws<p, positive finite denominator and finite signed balance, share both vapor and wick phase keys, and S(u)>=0. Otherwise refuse with a reason.
scope.evidence: Only an accepted negative lower endpoint adds wet_bulb_dry_bracket_c:[t,u].
unchanged: Unchecked signed helper arithmetic used by the public inverse
Existing vapor-pressure and wick-enthalpy phase choices
Mixing/cooling equations and established invalid-inlet propagation
scope.excluded: General invalid dry-bulb sanitation, exact real-fluid certification, new psychrometric phase models and any broad epsilon clipping.

preservation.boundary_full_hash: Retain original full hashes for every row. Require exact equality for the two anchors and far-upper controls and for any admitted untagged neighbor whose behavior is unchanged.
preservation.boundary_projection: Only the named predecessor/center/successor rows may omit the single wet_bulb_dry_bracket_c key; compare a tagged row with its stock result when all other output fields are unchanged. No blanket exclusion for physical results or refusal rows.
preservation.gates: All maintained CI stages and actual registered tool delivery checks; no workflow edits.

registered_pi.chart_control: ASHRAE Example1 40C/20C/101325Pa: W0.0065 +/-0.0002 and RH0.14 +/-0.01 are approximate chart-read checks. Recovered Twb20 +/-1e-8 is separately a model consistency check.
registered_pi.delivery: Actual tool.execute on unchanged registration/routing; all requests collected before assertions, dedicated unittest wrapper plus eight pytest cases.
registered_pi.limit: The frozen Pi cases do not exercise a bracket-bearing response. The direct router receiver checks bracket endpoints and positive zero; source review confirms the adapter forwards detail arrays without a whitelist.

first_execution: Matched stock/candidate maintained pull-request CI only after source, receivers, protocol, README and branch heads are frozen and preregistered. No local numerical execution or after-output oracle retuning.
receipt: Fetch each complete original CI log once; verify actual checkout trees, all named preservation hashes, inherited ordered records, and direct equality of the landed tree with a successful CI tree. If main advances, preserve both originals and qualify the combined tree separately.

primary_sources.title: ASHRAE Fundamentals2025 SI Chapter1, sections3/7, Table3 and Example1
primary_sources.interpretation: Nonnegative humidity follows its mass-ratio definition; adiabatic saturation supplies the approximate energy model. Table3 values are kPa converted to Pa, with broad intervals to accommodate the maintained correlation. The chapter's chart reads are approximate.

claim_limit: Maintained source qualification only; no model or contest score, timing result, exact transcendental arithmetic or exact thermodynamic-root certificate.
